reviews.title: Great toaster!!
reviews.body: We bought this toaster last year and have had many opportunities to use it. Thie Roter Mond 4 Slice Toaster Retro looks very cool on the counter. We got green! More importantly, it consistently toasts perfectly. On my side, I like it dark. My boyfriend’s side is on a lighter setting. Both sides toast perfectly for each of us and that is while toasting at the same time. Well worth the price!

reviews.title: Good for bagels, not so for white bread
reviews.body: This replaced a 15 year old toaster that started to give me problems.  This toaster looks great, has a defrost cycle, and a Bagel cycle.  The slots are wide enough for waffles, bagels, English Muffins, and most breads.BUT.  Some commercial rye bread is too long for the length of the slots, and thus have to be cut in half to fit.Toasting white bread is totally uneven as shown in their ad.  The heaters are separated and thus toast in bands with done and not done sections.  The waffles, bagels, English Muffins seem to toast ok.  The defrost cycle worked fine on waffles.I like the popup lever, a plus.  The defrost cycle is a plus.  The Cancel button is a plus.  The cleanout trays are a plus.The Amazon description says this is a 1,850 watt unit, and it is.  The wattage is 825 watts per side, so that if using both sides at once, you do not overload you wall receptacle or circuit breaker.

features: 1.5 inch Extra-Wide Slots: Roter Mond 4 slice toaster comes with food grade 18/8 stainless steel body. 1.5inch 4 slot extended heating surface allows for a wide variety of items to be toasted such as waffle, Muffin, bagel, etc.
6 Shade Settings: 6 level adjustable brown settings from light to dark to meet everyone's taste, 1650W high power & 360°baking mode will toast on both sides evenly and get hot fast
Basic Toasting Features: 3 Basic functions with Bagel/Defrost/Cancel. Solid high lift lever, fulfill different tastes at the same time. It would pop up automatically when bread is ready. More safer

Easy to Use & Clean : This 4 slice toaster makes 2 toasters in one to save your time for toasting. You can make your breakfast more easily. 2 removable crumb trays make cleaning quickly and cord wrap storage makes no mess

Retro Design Toaster: With compact and vitage design, this 4 slice toaster can save space on your countertop. It is also a great present for housewarming, Thanksgiving, Christmas, birthday, wedding, etc.
